question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is **"Pronunciation."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **"pronunciation"** with a** "u"** after the** "n."** • The incorrect spelling **"pronounciation"** is a common mistake due to the similarity in sound between **"pronounce" **and **"pronunciation."** • The correct spelling of the word is "pronunciation." • **"Pronunciation"** means the way in which a particular letter word or sound is said. (किसी शब्‍द या ध्वनि का उच्‍चारण) • **Example**:* She is an American **pronunciation**__.* • The correct answer is Option 4. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (Mischievous)** is correctly spelled and means causing or showing a fondness for causing trouble in a playful way. ((प्रायः बच्‍चों के लिए प्रयुक्त) शरारती, नटखट) • **Option 2 (Coincidence)** is correctly spelled and means a remarkable concurrence of events or circumstances without apparent causal connection. (दो या अधिक समान घटनाओं का संयोगवश और आश्‍चर्यजनक रूप से एक साथ घटित होना; सपांत, संयोग) • **Option 3 (Homogeneous)** is correctly spelled and means of the same kind or nature; essentially alike. (एक ही प्रकार के अंशों से निर्मित; समरूप, समांगी) 3b:Tc10, The correct answer is** "Important event."**
